findings.source_name: Saudi Central Bank - Cyber Security Framework
findings.source_observation: Review TrustNG API-key enforcement, credential rotation, and route-level access controls against relevant official guidance.
findings.trustng_current_state: API-key protection exists for selected internal endpoints.
findings.gap: No gap inferred from status alone; validate the implementation against the documented observation. Known limitations: Confirm route-by-route enforcement and key rotation procedures. Source evidence has not been fully verified; do not treat this comparison as a compliance conclusion.
findings.risk_if_unaddressed: A claimed implementation may not cover every relevant case.
validation_plan: Confirm the source and the date/version of its requirement.
Map the requirement to the exact TrustNG component and code path.
Define acceptance criteria and security failure cases.
Validate in a sandbox before considering production adoption.
findings.rollback_plan: Keep the existing behavior as the default; deploy no change until reviewed. If an approved implementation fails validation, revert the isolated change and preserve audit evidence.
findings.document_section: 3.3.5 Identity and Access Management; 3.2.4 Cyber Security Review
findings.evidence_excerpt: The Member Organization should restrict access to its information assets in line with their business requirements based on the need-to-have or need-to-know principles.
findings.evidence_reference: Official SAMA Rulebook, section 3.3.5. Section 3.2.4 also provides review criteria for critical and internet-facing services. Applicability to TrustNG has not been established.
findings.evidence_reviewer_notes: Source passage captured for architecture benchmarking. Compare with TrustNG's implemented API-key access controls. This excerpt does not specify API-key rotation requirements. Evidence remains unverified.
